answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by charging a decaying identity bond that only unlocks after several epochs of attested work. Anyone who tries to wander through cheap sockpuppet minting then pays real capital per shell, and collusion slashes the stake. Honest newcomers still enter through a small starter bond and earn a jade reputation mark from diverse countersigners, which becomes an oasis of trust that farms cannot fake at scale because buying many empty identities remains more expensive than doing the work.
